lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the five gill slits, forming distinct horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the circular blobs to form a visible lattice or matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity pixels (dorsal) to low-intensity shadow pixels (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated dark-pixel clusters (remoras) located near the ventral throat area and trailing the pectoral fin.
